images.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: final panorama illustration for an A4 children's adventure worksheet and storybook. Create ONE NEW story vignette from the approved character reference images, not a portrait row or a sheet. Style: exactly the soft hand-painted 2D pixel storybook style of the references, plump lovable shapes, crisp pixel edges, rich gentle shading; NOT a 3D render, voxel or Minecraft blocks. Pure WHITE background (#ffffff), only small pale cyan grounding shadows and a few gentle light particles, economical and readable in grayscale printing. Very wide horizontal 3:1 composition, target 2160x720, all characters full body with feet inside frame and clear silhouettes, spread along the width in natural expressive cooperative poses. No background room, no landscape, no fortress. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, no names, letters, numbers, captions, labels, equations, speech bubbles, QR codes, watermarks or puzzle solutions. Existing intrinsic abstract face marks and connector/keyhole/emblem shapes may remain. Input images are STRICT character identity/style references, not composition to copy. Do not invent extra cast or change costumes.
Identities: Piko = blue scalloped cloud-head with a dark face screen and cyan terminal-style eyes, black suit, white shirt, teal tie. Miky = cream microphone body, dark rounded mesh grille, teal U-shaped support/arms and cream-teal feet, gold pivots, no scarf. Pixi = warm yellow square pixel face inside ivory bezel with four gold corner screws, small cream feet/hands. Plugy = cream living USB plug with exposed metal rectangular connector above smiling face, blue flexible ARMS and LEGS, orange gloves, cream shoes; absolutely NO CABLE TAIL, no extra connector. Pingy = cream-and-mint living envelope with green triangular flap, cream hands and mint shoes, no human cap or courier bag. Cipko = green microchip square body, gold contact pins, big black square eyeglasses, dark-green shoes. Guardy = ornate orange living SHIELD body, friendly ivory face, TEAL TIE directly under face, glowing cyan KEYHOLE below tie, orange hands/feet; no generic robot helmet or torso, no padlock icon.
Scene: EXACTLY TWO characters: Piko and Miky ONLY. Piko holds his tiny blank communicator toward Miky, Miky listens with a hand to his teal support. Between them a few interrupted cyan signal dots are reconnecting, an intimate hopeful exchange. Show warm eye contact. No other companions, no pixel or shield character, no final victory.
